description: Security audit of a GitHub Actions workflow YAML (zizmor / actionlint style): pwn-request checkouts under pull_request_target / workflow_run, script injection from attacker-controlled ${{ github.event.* }} contexts in run: and github-script, actions not pinned to a commit SHA, missing or write-all permissions, toJSON(secrets), secrets in workflow-wide env, self-hosted runners on PR triggers, persisted checkout credentials, disabled ::set-env / ::add-path commands, curl | bash, cache poisoning in release workflows, artifact poisoning, spoofable bot-actor conditions and hard-coded credentials. Findings carry line numbers, severity and the fix. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gha-workflow-lint
name: gha_workflow_lint
title: Gha Workflow Lint
